summary: garage_sectional / residential double garage door: floating_part; other_obviously_wrong

findings.description: There is no wall between the top of the door opening and the header: a 2.21 m tall hole the full width of the opening, open to the sky. The hole exists so the leaf can slide up inside the wall plane without interpenetrating it.
The opener motor hangs 3 m out from the wall on the end of an unsupported rail, in a scene with no ceiling to hang it from and no drop straps: a black box in mid-air.
